result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the page, mostly minor layout and content concerns. The page is generally functional but has a couple of presentational problems.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row shows a truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol' without an ellipsis, making it unclear that the name is cut off. The card is also partially clipped by the screen edge in a way that hides both the image and the name awkwardly.
issues.suggestion: Ensure truncated text always ends with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccolo...') so users understand the name is incomplete. Consider adjusting card widths or peek amount so the partial card is more clearly a scroll hint.

issues.description: The bottom-most restaurant card (pizza item) is cut off mid-image with no visual indicator that it is scrollable, which could confuse users into thinking the content ends there.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll indicator, fade overlay, or ensure at least a sliver of the next card is visible to clearly communicate that more content is available below.
